name: io.github.kieksme/hashnode-mcp
title: Hashnode MCP
description: MCP server for the Hashnode GraphQL API — create drafts, publish posts, and manage publications.

environmentVariables.name: HASHNODE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hashnode Personal Access Token from https://hashnode.com/settings/developer

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token MCP clients must send (Authorization: Bearer …). Comma-separated list allowed for rotation.

environmentVariables.name: HASHNODE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hashnode Personal Access Token (or use HASHNODE_CREDENTIAL_MODE=header + X-Hashnode-Token).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist (required when binding beyond localhost).
